summary: Iteration 9: Verified the CLEANUP + SIMPLIFICATION pass (duplicate CTA removal + no-crystal AI Factory rebuild). Backend pytest suite 7/7 passed. Frontend: /ai-factory has 0 canvases (no WebGL), the Factory Index has exactly 3 mode tabs (case-studies default open), the 12 solutions render grouped by 4 industries with correct calyza/blueprint chips, solution briefs unfold with the nested MiniModel, deep links (?industry=fintech, ?mode=ready-to-deploy&solution=claimkavach, ?mode=use-cases&industry=hospitality) all resolve correctly, bogus params do not crash. Old footer-cta-button removed on every audited page (0 occurrences globally), site-footer still renders with logo+nav+Book a Strategy Call. Homepage has exactly 1 canvas and 1 closing-cta; no duplicate 'Ready to build' endings. All 11 routes render with non-empty bodies and zero console errors.
action_items: MINOR / OPTIONAL: When ALL three URL params are bogus (?mode=bogus&solution=bogus&industry=bogus), the mode resolves to 'use-cases' with the fallback industry (healthcare) because industryParam is a truthy string. The spec says bogus values should degrade to the 'valid default' (case-studies). It does not crash and content still renders. If strict-default behaviour is required, gate industryParam through FACTORY_INDUSTRIES.find before treating it as truthy in AIFactoryPage mode-resolution.

MINOR / OPTIONAL: SolutionBrief testids include the solution id suffix (brief-problem-rbi-regtech, brief-intelligence-rbi-regtech, brief-workflow-rbi-regtech, brief-deployment-rbi-regtech) rather than the plain brief-problem/brief-intelligence/brief-workflow/brief-deployment testids mentioned verbatim in the review request. All four sections do render and mini-model-{understand,decide,deploy} exist. Only flag if strict testid parity is required.
critical_code_review_comments: AIFactoryPage.jsx mode-resolution treats industryParam='bogus' as truthy and opens use-cases mode with the healthcare fallback — safer to require getFactoryIndustry to match before switching modes.
SolutionBrief child testids embed the solution id (brief-problem-{id} etc.); consider adding an alias parent testid per section for testability.
